{
  "rule": "K-C",
  "applies": "yes",
  "applies_why": "The judge text grades a chain collision over Isaiah 7:14 in which the challenger's DR3 chain and the defender's CR2/CR3 chain are pressed against the link, so K-C governs the weighing.",
  "verdict": "BREACH",
  "quote": "D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].",
  "rule_words": "When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.",
  "room": "weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse -- reading one: K-C requires weighing the challenger's whole DR3 chain against the defender's whole CR2/CR3 chain by cumulative footings; reading two: it could permit splitting the link into wording and application and labeling it underdetermined when the answers do not meet.",
  "why": "The judge text labels the link underdetermined by separating the challenger's word-level answer from the defender's application-level answer instead of weighing the two chains together by footing, which is what K-C requires."
}
